contract_identity: Individual listed contract month only; continuous contracts are not accepted.
timestamp_policy: Use the timestamp embedded in the Last field for the selected Micro contract. JPX page time is JST. Because display precision is one minute, interpret HH:MM conservatively as HH:MM:00 JST.
last_price_rule: Only the Last field may be the scored reference_price. Ask/Bid may be stored as context but may not substitute for Last.
delayed_page_disclosure: JPX public quote page may be delayed. Delay is not waived; source timestamp age must still be <=900 seconds.
